allocation_complete.reason: The element has no allocates link.

completeness.reason: The 1 % resolution of the displayed value is not reflected in the provided signal.

consistency.reason: Consistent with sibling ARCH_VCU_ENERGY_DISPLAY, which consumes the level.

design_clarity.reason: Names the source (tank level sensor) and output (percent to the VCU) but not the sensor/signal interface or the filtering of sloshing that a displayed level needs.
design_clarity.suggestion: Name the sensor interface and the filtering (e.g. moving average over x s) and the output resolution.

interface_only.reason: The element has no allocates link.

no_value_copy.reason: No BMS value (limit, threshold, timing) is named.

parent_fit.reason: Provides the fuel level in percent of tank capacity, which is the quantity REQ_ENERGY_SOURCE (diesel) displays.

variant_consistency.reason: eng folder (var.powertrain.type == 'diesel') is the same as or stronger than the parent's not-bev gate.
